findings.title: 미완료 HTTP·viewport·step/close 실측을 가공
findings.evidence: pending status0/ended null rewritten to200/currenttime; Node AUTH_FORBIDDEN rewrites actual status to403; viewport/origin constants; positive acquisition stamps at steps and close stamps after helper return rather than actual callbacks. Actual SDK viewport1440x901 produced raw1440x900. Invalid helper state with no entered step/resources and cleanup error still creates worker-final FAIL_INCOMPLETE.
findings.proof: real SDK viewport probe plus invalid-state-published actual exported helper; whole owner did FAIL, not false PASS

findings.title: query/request identity와 JSON drain 계약 이탈
findings.evidence: postDataJSON not called; unknown query keys silently dropped; response matched by URL+status0 rather than actual Request identity; status set before awaiting JSON, drain checks status0 only, parse errors swallowed, leftover status0 fabricated200. Source helper returned stripped query and postDataJSONCalls0.

findings.title: Held timeout 정리·실패 경로 release/abort 누락

findings.proof: held-success-timer-leak actual helper; pending-route failure cleanup source-verified

findings.evidence: owned directory junction points read-only to exact verifier dir; positive live-admin and negative errors CLI skip main and exit0, empty streams; realpath comparison required. No browser/network/production mutation used.

findings.title: fixture env 정리 및 normal ACK wire contract 이탈
findings.evidence: bootstrap gets ambient env; child filter omits AUTH_BOOTSTRAP_*,NODE_DEBUG,non-A1 SOL. No sanitized env passed to ensureAuthBootstrapCredentials. Normal wire ACK uses nonceSha256 instead of original protocol2 nonce echo followed by storage-only hash projection. Historical core ABI remains tested; no auth/IPC bypass claimed.
